text:
Alex G: FYI getting a flurry of p95/p99 slack alerts starting 21:10 UTC after last runtime rollout. Customers with long-context workloads (seqs ~1024-2048) reporting elevated tail latency.

deploy-bot: deploy r-inference-runtime @ commit ff9a21 merged and rolled at 2026-03-14T20:58:34Z

Maria Ops: console shows p95 jumped from ~180ms -> ~620ms for model gpt-neo-medium@v2 on us-east-1. p99 up to ~1.3s. error rates unchanged. This looks like perf regression not correctness.

Chen Infra: grabbing traces now. Early hypothesis: new kernel selection heuristics flipped some hosts to flash_attn_v3 / SDPA mixed path. p50 mostly stable but tail exploded.

Lisa ML: past benching showed flash_attn_v3 helps short contexts but can regress for longer seqs when qkv packing is enabled — extra device-to-device memcpy + strided access. Which kernel binary was chosen?

Alex G: quick local repro (notes):
```
# reproduce
export RW_USE_FLASHATTN=1
export RW_SDPA_POLICY=enabled
python bench.py --model gpt-neo-medium --seq 1536 --batch 1 --iters 200
```
Outputs: p95 ~650ms when flash enabled; forcing sdpa_fallback improves p95 to ~210ms.

Maria Ops: can we flip a config to prefer sdpa_fallback for the affected model while we investigate? We have per-model kernel_override in config-store.

Chen Infra: applied kernel_override=sdpa_fallback for gpt-neo-medium@v2 in us-east-1 to 20% canary. Propagating to 100% if canary looks good.

ops-bot: canary metrics: p95 on canary hosts dropped from 610ms -> 230ms within 7 minutes.

Alex G: logs from regressed host show:
```
[2026-03-14T21:05:11Z] selected_kernel=flash_attn_v3
[2026-03-14T21:05:11Z] seq_len=1536 batch=1 q_bits=4 packed_qkv=1
[2026-03-14T21:05:11Z] memcpy_ms=19.8 compute_ms=75 total_infer_ms=132
```
Good host:
```
selected_kernel=sdpa_fallback
seq_len=1536 batch=1 q_bits=4 packed_qkv=0
memcpy_ms=3.9 compute_ms=116 total_infer_ms=120
```

Lisa ML: interesting — compute is higher on the sdpa path but memcpy dominates on flash path when packed_qkv true. Hypothesis: our compile default for flash enabled -DPACKED_QKV_LAYOUT which introduces an extra pack/unpack step. Try building runtime with -DLEGACY_QKV_LAYOUT=1 to avoid packing.

Alex G: I built a local test runtime with -DLEGACY_QKV_LAYOUT=1 and ran the same bench: p95 improved ~18% versus flash_attn_v3 previous build. Not enough to fully close gap in production but promising.

Chen Infra: mitigation plan options: rollback the kernel-selection heuristics, pin kernel_override per-model, or roll back entire runtime commit. Fastest path is pin kernel_override while ML fixes and we add safer gating. What do you prefer?

Maria Ops: pin override and then rollback if noise continues. Need customer comms ready.

Chen Infra: pinned kernel_override for gpt-neo-medium@v2 in region us-east-1 and us-west-2. Canary -> 100% completed by 21:22 UTC. Alerts showing tail returning to baseline.

support-bot: created INC-5289 for impacted tenants and added initial mitigation note. Suggested customer message: "We've temporarily reverted a runtime optimization that increased latency for long-context requests. We're actively investigating and will follow up with technical details."

Lisa ML: action items:
- exhaustive perf matrix across seq_len [256,512,1024,1536,2048,4096], batch sizes [1,2,4], and quant paths [8bit,4bit].
- add CI perf gating: any kernel selection change must show no p95 regression on the matrix.
- propose runtime change: add local trial-run metric — when switching kernel, measure tail on small experiment traffic; if tail worsens, auto-fallback.

Alex G: created repro tarball and uploaded to s3: s3://redwood-repro/kernel-issue/1765019876.tgz (contains bench scripts, traces, Dockerfile with patched runtime).

Chen Infra: logs from rollout host with override pinned:
```
[2026-03-14T21:26:40Z] kernel_override=sdpa_fallback
[2026-03-14T21:26:40Z] seq_len=1536 batch=1 q_bits=4 packed_qkv=0
[2026-03-14T21:26:40Z] p95=228ms p99=340ms
```

Maria Ops: given rollback isn't needed now, let's keep kernel_override for 48h and only unpin after PERF-1210 shows green. Also schedule customer follow-up with comms.

Lisa ML: I'll open tracker PERF-1210 "FlashAttention v3 regressions for long contexts" with reproducer and initial perf numbers and assign owners. Plan to PR two things: (1) runtime - trial-run + auto-fallback, (2) compiler patch option -DLEGACY_QKV_LAYOUT to test reduced memcpy.

Alex G: assign owners for postmortem: detection/alerts = Maria Ops, mitigation/ops = Chen Infra, kernel analysis + reproducer = Lisa ML, CI perf gate = Alex G.

ops-bot: incident INC-5289 updated: canary -> pinned override -> metrics stabilize. Customers notified.

Chen Infra: I'll keep the pinned override and add a canary gating change to limit automatic kernel flips to <0.5% traffic for any new kernel selection for the next month.

Lisa ML: opening PRs today for runtime fallback logic and for a test compile that disables packing. ETA for first PR: EOW.

Alex G: thanks all. Closing the thread here; moving actions into INC-5289 and PERF-1210. Ping in this thread if anything else crops up.
